content:
maria: Quick shoutout — @ravi fixed the office microwave this morning after it started sparking. Saved 7 lunches and at least one demo. :tada:
ravi: haha thanks! Found a loose connector, reseated it and taped the mystery wire. Please don’t microwave metal tongs? :grimacing:
sam: legend. We should give Ravi a golden microwave sticker. :star:
jordan: Also big thanks for grabbing my bagel when I was late to standup — rescued my afternoon. :bagel:
priya: Can we put a tiny ‘do not microwave metal’ note on the machine? I’ll print a laminated one unless someone beats me to it. :printer:
emily: I can make a little sticker sheet — microwave etiquette heroes. Will drop in kitchen later. :sparkles: @maria want me to include a tiny QR to the office incident guide?
maria: Yes please! And maybe a tiny ‘microwave whisperer’ badge for Ravi. :laughing: Ops-bot: Incident logged: #kitchen-2026-0423-01 — microwave electrical sparking. Assigned: ravi. Priority: low.
ravi: Added a follow-up to replace the heating plate next month. Thanks all for the quick help and snacks saved. :raised_hands:
sam: Celebratory cookie run on me tomorrow for the microwave heroics. Who’s in? :cookie: :raised_hands:
jordan: Count me in. Also pro tip: label your tongs. Learned the hard way. :sweat_smile:
